behavior: @deepseek-ai/dsh-otel resolves to CurrentOTel and provides ctx.otel through Cordis Service ownership. Mounting allocates no reporter queue or collector request.
createEventReporter and createSessionLogReporter return independent caller-owned channels. Disposing the provider removes ctx.otel while accepted channel work remains owned by consumers.
Both channels now have qualified end-to-end HTTP composition through the factory. The service does not supply business identity, authorization, redaction or collector defaults.
The package manifest is copied byte-for-byte from the pinned Source. Bundle/profile composition and production consumer migration are separate follow-up changes.
limitations: The existing session backend still uses the historical Python SDK transport until its next consumer migration. Production bundle/profile promotion has not been claimed by this provider commit.
Existing transport/channel adaptation limits remain. Full migration/release, Portable/browser and Windows 7 qualification remain pending.
